type.prompt: Investigate issue #51: ralph.yml has many placeholders that are not replaced. This is a bug in the botminter project (project/botminter label). The operator reported that ralph.yml doesn't get replaced with proper placeholder values - they saw <project> and {{something}} in ralph.yml of superman after hiring. Investigate the template rendering code in projects/botminter/ to find why placeholders aren't being substituted during bm hire or bm teams sync. Classify as simple or complex bug and report findings on the issue.
